description: This file defines the InceptionApi class extending OpenAIApi, implementing custom methods for chat and edit completions, including streaming and non-streaming variants, with special handling for tokens indicating next edits or apply actions. It interacts with a specific API endpoint and manages message tokens and streaming responses.

classes.name: InceptionApi
classes.description: A class extending OpenAIApi with custom methods for handling chat and edit completions, including streaming and non-streaming, with special token handling for next edit and apply commands.

methods.name: editCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams edit completion responses from the custom endpoint.

methods.name: editCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Fetches a non-streaming edit completion from the custom endpoint.

methods.name: chatCompletionStream
methods.description: Overrides the chat stream method to route to edit or apply endpoints based on message tokens.

methods.name: chatCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Overrides the non-streaming chat method to route to edit or apply endpoints based on message tokens.

methods.name: applyCompletionStream
methods.description: Streams apply completion responses from the custom endpoint.

methods.name: applyCompletionNonStream
methods.description: Fetches a non-streaming apply completion from the custom endpoint.

methods.name: fimStream
methods.description: Streams responses for the fim endpoint, handling server-sent events.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Method not implemented, intended to list models.

methods.name: isNextEdit
methods.description: Checks if messages contain the token indicating a next edit.

methods.name: isApply
methods.description: Checks if messages contain the token indicating an apply command.

methods.name: removeToken
methods.description: Removes specified token from the last message content.

methods.name: streamCustomEndpoint
methods.description: Streams data from a custom API endpoint with server-sent events.

methods.name: nonStreamCustomEndpoint
methods.description: Fetches data from a custom API endpoint without streaming.
